meta.name: story-review
meta.description: 多视角对抗式审查。full/lean 模式在已部署 reviewer agents 时并行 spawn；缺失/异常 agents 或 spawn 失败时自动降级 solo，参考文件不可读时使用内置 rubric fallback。触发方式：/story-review、/审查、「审查一下」「帮我审一下」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查你的需求描述,多角度找出遗漏和矛盾。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在写需求或功能说明时,想获得多角度的检查意见。
copy.tagline_en: Review your requirement description from multiple angles for gaps and conflicts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write requirement or feature specs and want multiple perspectives before finalizing.

howto.what: 它会把小说从结构、角色、文字、设定等角度挑毛病，按 S1~S4 标严重度并给出可执行修改建议；只出报告，不改正文。可用 full/lean 并行多视角审，失败自动降级 solo，并按番茄/起点/知乎等平台标准核对。
howto.when: 当用户输入 /story-review(可加 full/lean/solo)、/审查，或说「帮我审一下」等触发词时；未指定模式默认 full。

say.text: /story-review 审第三章，看结构、节奏和钩子问题。
say.note: full 模式会并行多个审查视角，异常时降级 solo。

say.text: 用 lean 帮我审第 1、2 章，只要结构和连贯性问题。
say.note: lean 只做故事架构与一致性两个视角。

say.text: 帮我审一下第 8 章，角色对话和人物动机怪不怪。
say.note: 按 S1~S4 标严重度，并给行号和替换方向。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews given fiction adversarially: spots structure/character/prose/setting problems, rates S1-S4, lists fixes. Report only. full/lean spawn reviewer agents in parallel, fall back to solo; rubrics: Fanqie/Qidian/Zhihu etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-review (optionally with full/lean/solo), /审查, or a phrase like 帮我审一下; defaults to full when no mode is set.

say_en.text: /story-review Review chapter 3 — structure, pacing, and hooks.
say_en.note: Full mode: multiple perspectives; falls back to solo.

say_en.text: Run a lean review of chapters 1-2, only structure and consistency.
say_en.note: Lean covers architecture and consistency only.

say_en.text: Review chapter 8 — do dialogue and character motivation feel off?
say_en.note: Issues are rated S1-S4 with line references.
